name: setup-manaflow-ai-apple-look
description: A whole cmux look built only from public surfaces, after Notes, Mail and Xcode on macOS 26: theme files for color, material and proportions (Apple, light, the default; Apple Dark), settings for SF Pro type, the chat column and source-list rows, a stylesheet of cmux.agentPane.style/1 tokens for a Messages-style prompt bubble and macOS menus, and a customize view for a popover-like hover card. Remove it and everything you had comes back.

files.customize/cmux-app.json:
{
  "$schema": "https://cmux.dev/schemas/cmux-app/2.json",
  "manifestVersion": 2,
  "id": "local/customize",
  "name": { "en": "Apple sidebar" },
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "description": "Apple's hover card and sidebar rows: a macOS popover (bold title, gray secondary lines) and source-list rows with the system spinner.",
  "engines": { "cmux": "^2.0" },
  "repository": "https://github.com/local/customize",
  "runtime": { "main": "main.js" },
  "implements": {
    "cmux.hovercard/1": { "export": "renderCard" },
    "cmux.sidebar.rows/1": { "export": "decorateRows" }
  },
  "scopes": { "workspace:read": "Name the rows to decorate." },
  "activation": ["onInterface:cmux.hovercard/1", "onInterface:cmux.sidebar.rows/1"],
  "files": ["main.js"]
}
